title: One ordinary transition from an encoded configuration
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, let $r_1,r_2$ be register indices, and let $c$ be a configuration with state set $\Lambda$. For a state $s\in\Lambda$ and position $k\in\mathbb Z$, form the configuration with state $s$ and both register heads at position $k$. If $P$ has no oracle call at $s$, then one step of its run from this configuration equals applying the machine transition prescribed by $P$ for state $s$, the scanned input symbol, and the scanned work-tape symbols.
hypotheses_covered: The program $P$ and oracle are given.
The register indices $r_1,r_2$ and configuration $c$ are given.
The state $s$ and integer position $k$ are given.
There is no oracle call at state $s$.
